text: [excited] Fans waited thirteen years for this game... then the trucks started flying!
Grand Theft Auto Six finally launched this week.
[impressed] An estimated seventeen million copies, in about a day.
[fast] One truck got flung across the entire map.
A boat got stuck between a bridge and a wall, shaking like it saw a ghost.
[whispers] And one hero sank straight through the road.
[deadpan] The critics' score? Ninety-nine out of a hundred. A tie for the all-time record.
[playfully] Would you play it with flying trucks? Send this to the friend who called in sick today.
